name: HOLDINGS_WRITER_ORDERING_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: HOLDINGS_WRITER_ORDERING_20261103 — a holdings writer that changes rows reconciles every derived total it invalidates at the one gate: portfolio_totals.total_value and total_cash, each account_summaries cash figure that already carries cash, the last_writer provenance record, and the removal of a note whose claim the write has made false. Rows are never rewritten by the reconciliation.
